config switch-controller managed-switch
    edit "S000SSSS00000001"
        set fsw-wan1-peer "fortilink"
        set fsw-wan1-admin enable
        config ports
            edit "port1"
                set vlan "_default"
                set allowed-vlans "quarantine"
                set untagged-vlans "quarantine"
            next

                set untagged-vlans "quarantine"
